_readme: Videoannoncer til Google Ads, én per anledning.
Hver video er 10 sekunder og bygget i to dele:
0,0–6,0 s  scene: anledningen, animeret fra et still (Runway gen4_turbo)
6,0–10,0 s afslutning: det faktiske produkt vi udlejer, pris og lejhojtaler.dk
Scenen laves med gen4_image, som får produktfotoet med som reference, så det er
vores eget udstyr der står i billedet og ikke en opdigtet højtaler med
volapyk-logo. Det er hele grunden til at vi ikke bruger text-to-video: en
udlejningsforretning kan ikke reklamere med udstyr den ikke har.
Priserne skal matche lejhojtaler.dk. De er hentet fra /api/products 17-08-2026;
ændrer admin en pris i KV, skal videoen rendres og uploades igen. Derfor står
prisen kun i afslutningen — ét sted at rette.
PMax kræver mindst 10 sekunders video. Google accepterer 16:9, 1:1 og 9:16;
build_videos.py laver alle tre fra samme master.

occasions.headline: Lyd til brylluppet
occasions.sub: Talerne bliver hørt. Dansen holder til sent.
occasions.scene_prompt: Danish wedding reception in a bright rustic barn venue at dusk, long tables with white linen and candles, guests seated listening to a speech, the referenced PA speaker on a stand at the edge of the dance floor, warm string lights overhead, soft natural window light, photographic, shallow depth of field, no text
occasions.motion_prompt: Slow steady push in toward the dance floor. Candle flames flicker, guests turn their heads and applaud gently, string lights sway. Static camera height, no zoom snap, cinematic and calm.

occasions.headline: Konfirmation i haven
occasions.sub: Musik og lys, klar på en halv time.
occasions.scene_prompt: Danish garden party on a summer afternoon, family and teenagers around tables under a white pavilion, the referenced speaker on a stand beside the terrace, string lights strung between trees, hedge and brick house in the background, soft late-day sun, photographic, no text
occasions.motion_prompt: Gentle drift to the right across the garden. Leaves and string lights move in a light breeze, people talk and laugh, a teenager walks past the speaker. Handheld feel, subtle, no fast motion.

occasions.headline: Fest i baghaven
occasions.scene_prompt: Danish backyard party after dark, twenty friends dancing on a lawn between old apartment buildings, the referenced battery-powered speaker standing on the grass, string lights and a few colored lights, purple dusk sky, photographic, warm and lively, no text
occasions.motion_prompt: Slow arc around the dancing crowd. People move to the beat, string lights twinkle, colored light spills across the grass. Night-time energy, smooth camera, no strobe.

occasions.headline: Møde, konference, firmafest
occasions.sub: Projektor og mikrofon der virker første gang.
occasions.scene_prompt: Danish company presentation in a bright modern meeting room, twenty colleagues seated facing a large projected slide, the referenced projector on a table in the foreground, daylight through tall windows, clean Scandinavian interior, photographic, no readable text on the screen
occasions.motion_prompt: Slow push in past the projector toward the audience. A presenter gestures, colleagues shift and take notes, dust drifts through the projector beam. Calm, professional, steady.

occasions.headline: Karaokeaften derhjemme
occasions.sub: To mikrofoner, skærm og tusindvis af sange.
occasions.scene_prompt: Danish living room karaoke night, two friends singing into microphones and laughing, the referenced karaoke system set up beside a TV, others on the sofa cheering, warm lamp light and a few colored party lights, photographic, cosy, no readable text on the screen
occasions.motion_prompt: Slight handheld drift toward the singers. They laugh mid-song, the crowd on the sofa cheers and claps, colored lights sweep the wall. Warm, informal, alive.

occasions.headline: Fest hvor der ingen strøm er
occasions.sub: Batteri til hele aftenen. Vejer 8 kilo.
occasions.scene_prompt: Danish students celebrating in a city park at golden hour, a group dancing on the grass around the referenced portable battery speaker, bicycles and picnic blankets, trees and Copenhagen rooftops behind, warm low sun flare, photographic, no text
occasions.motion_prompt: Slow drift in toward the speaker on the grass. Students dance and jump, a bicycle rolls past in the background, sun flare shifts across the lens. Loose, summery, real.
